title: MacroPulse Alert
message:
ETH spot ETFs: record $2.85B weekly net inflow vs $548M for BTC — institutional tilt to ETH accelerating.
Iran ceasefire expired (Mon Aug 18). Trump rejected extension. WTI oil +1.2% to $84.77.
US Treasury GENIUS Act stablecoin NPRM published Aug 18 in Federal Register. Effective Jan 2027, 60-day comment window.
Sept hike odds ~33% (up from 10% post-retail miss Aug 14) ahead of FOMC Minutes tomorrow 2pm ET.
White House crypto summit tomorrow Aug 19 2:30pm ET — Trump, SEC/CFTC chairs, Coinbase, Ripple, Kraken.
